issue.title: EQL: Avoid filtering on tiebreakers

labels.name: Team:QL (Deprecated)
labels.description: Meta label for query languages team

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Do not filter by tiebreaker while searching sequence matches as
it's not monotonic and thus can filter out valid data.

Fix #62781

issue.title: EQL: Avoid filtering on tiebreakers

labels.name: Team:QL (Deprecated)
labels.description: Meta label for query languages team

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Do not filter by tiebreaker while searching sequence matches as
it's not monotonic and thus can filter out valid data.
Add handling for data 'near' the boundary that has the same timestamp
but different tie-breaker and thus can be just outside the window.

Fix #62781
Relates #63215
